name: Solanaceae Bacterial Spot
symptoms: Small brown water-soaked spots on leaves Circular lesions without concentric rings Spots merging to form large dark streaks Yellowing of leaves around lesions Leaves may drop early (defoliation) Raised scab-like spots on fruits
description: Bacterial spot is a serious bacterial disease affecting tomatoes and peppers. It causes dark water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit, leading to defoliation and reduced yield. The disease spreads easily in warm and wet conditions.
management: Use certified disease-free seeds Rotate crops for 2–3 years Remove infected plant debris Avoid working in fields when plants are wet Use resistant varieties when available
prevention: Use healthy transplants Maintain field sanitation Control weeds and volunteer plants Monitor crops regularly during warm wet weather
